models.label: Powerful
models.note: ReDimNet2-B6, 3 s window. Most accurate (Hindi phone speech: 1.7% error at 1 s vs 6.7%, 0.6% in echo vs 2.6%). Heavier on the processor - about a second per check on a mid-range phone. 26 MB.

models.label: Medium
models.note: ECAPA-TDNN, 6 s window. Lighter on the processor (better for budget phones), less accurate in noise. The model every phone used before 5.1.23. 42 MB.
